explication: Checkstyle is a Java code-quality tool. Its principal workflow takes source files and a user configuration through the command-line entry point, runs configured checks, and reports violations. The README documents this audit workflow; sampled CLI code confirms configuration loading and listener selection, and sampled checks show AST-based violation reporting. The repository also exposes a GUI and XPath query generation. Core parser, checker, and listener wiring is represented at package-directory level because those implementations were not sampled.
